shows.title: Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater - New Works
shows.description: A mixed bill of contemporary dance featuring three UK premieres alongside two established works. The programme spans intimate duets, spiritual meditations and athletic ensemble pieces — all anchored in powerful musical partnerships — and closes with Alvin Ailey's iconic Revelations, the most widely seen modern dance work in the world.
